why: No author repository, code link, or artifact was released — only a prose/table description of the pipeline (IQR cleaning, label encoding, correlation/RF feature selection, SMOTE, GridSearchCV, soft-voting/stacking). The match target C1 is a small CPU tabular stacking job whose components (RF, XGBoost, LightGBM, SVC, logistic meta-learner, 10-fold OOF) are all standard and fully specified enough to rebuild from the paper, so the right strategy is reimplementation from the claim contract rather than hunting for nonexistent code.
missing_artifacts: Exact preprocessing script and Table-2 label-encoding map
Exact GridSearchCV search grids (Table 7 only partially quoted: LightGBM 200 estimators, lr 0.2, max_depth 7)
Full-Filled Brain Stroke Dataset CSV (Kaggle, may require credentials)
Exact random seeds for base learners and stack folds
blockers_seen: Kaggle dataset download may require authentication/API token
Paper text is the only specification of the preprocessing order; SMOTE-before-split vs after split ambiguity must be resolved to match numbers
Reported 97.2% accuracy on a ~5% prevalence dataset is unusually high; exact number may depend on undocumented leakage or tuning details

feasibility.est_runtime_on_this_machine: 10–25 minutes: load ~5k rows, IQR filter to ~4.3k, SMOTE, fit 4 base learners with modest grid search and 10-fold OOF meta-features, then evaluate the stack on the 868-row test set

compute.basis: Small tabular dataset (~4.3k rows, 10 features); stacking with 4 base learners, 10-fold OOF and modest grid search on a laptop CPU, roughly 10–30 s per tuned model family and seconds per fold fit.
